note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Thirteen of the fourteen divisions were filled by a single nomination and are listed from the nomination reports. In Glenmachiernan a contest was expected between Mr. John Hamilton and Mr. Hugh Osborne (the retiring member); the poll result was not traced in the papers available, so that division is not recorded here. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
